description: Purpose: fetch one carbon black grade in full - the six ASTM parameters as min/max ranges with their test-method standards, application list, process route, brand owner for conductive grades, and for rCB types a gap analysis against the virgin N550 anchor on iodine / DBP / BET / ash / heating loss / sieve residue. Guidelines: use the semantic id (rcb-grade-n550 / rcb-grade-xc72 / rcb-grade-rcb-general) or the grade name ('N550', 'Super P','rCB-General'); pair with query_grades to discover ids and get_grade_spec for specification detail. Limits: one grade per call; ranges are compiled from public specifications and are not a supplier's guaranteed certificate of analysis; the gap analysis is relative to N550 only, not to every virgin grade. Ex: get_grade(id='rcb-grade-n550'), get_grade(name='Super P'), get_grade(name='rCB-General', response_format='json').

id.description: 语义化实体 ID，如 rcb-grade-n550 / rcb-grade-xc72 / rcb-grade-rcb-general

name.description: 牌号名（与 id 二选一），如 'N550'、'N660'、'N330'、'Super P'、'rCB-General'

response_format.description: 输出格式：markdown=人类阅读, json=Agent 处理友好

name: get_grade

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).

title: Get Grade Detail
